changelog:
Playlist properties: right-click any playlist for its track count, total time, size on disk and what is left to download — plus Download All Tracks, and the day you made it.

Fixes: Next now plays the next track of the list you are playing, not of the playlist you happen to be looking at. The Library can be dragged onto a playlist under any sort, and a drag no longer needs the song selected first. The lyrics panel now actually slides open instead of appearing in two frames.
